rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when an action is done subtly through skill rather than force.

example.traditional: 佢巧妙咁避開咗個陷阱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haau2 miu6 gam3 bei6 hoi1 zo2 go3 ham6 zing6

rows.note: Use this when someone acts subtly without revealing their intentions or showing any reaction.

example.english: They subtly put the paper away without showing any reaction.
example.traditional: 佢不動聲色咁將張紙收埋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 dung6 sing1 sik1 gam3 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 sau1 maai4

rows.note: Use this mainly when someone conveys a message, refusal, or criticism subtly and tactfully.

example.english: They subtly turned down my invitation.
example.traditional: 佢婉轉咁拒絕咗我嘅邀請。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jyun2 zyun2 gam3 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 jiu1 cing2
